issue.title: Jack's routing lost & traceback if port don't curently exist

findings.detail: Source uses submodules. Their availability and exact revisions need a separate dependency check. Resolved for this revision: The only submodule is scripts/flatpak/shared-modules; the repair and focused tests touch the JACK sink Python file and do not invoke Flatpak packaging.

resolution.reason: The only submodule is scripts/flatpak/shared-modules; the repair and focused tests touch the JACK sink Python file and do not invoke Flatpak packaging.
evidence: tests/test_jack_sink_routing.py uses standard-library AST extraction and JACK doubles

findings.detail: pyproject.toml references Git/local/workspace dependencies; resolve them before scheduling a build. Resolved for this revision: The Git-pinned audio dependencies are not installed or imported by the focused test, which extracts the pure routing helper and supplies a deterministic JACK double.

limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.
Dependency manifests are scanned heuristically; transitive dependencies, availability of registry packages, native libraries and physical equipment are not verified.
Only explicit PR references are matched; semantically related work without links can be missed.
Runtime compatibility, contribution policy and complete reproduction steps still require engineering review.

dimensions.reason: A missing live audio client causes traceback output and destroys the usable JACK route during show preparation.
The external issue was opened less than one day before selection.
Reporter supplied exact current-version reproduction steps and the expected offline-editing behavior.
A missing configured port must leave the current route intact; an available port must replace it.
Three deterministic JACK-double tests fail on the pinned baseline and pass with the repair.
The change is confined to JACK route reconciliation plus one focused test file.
Routing decisions and error handling are fully testable without physical hardware.
Available targets keep the prior replacement behavior; only incomplete target sets retain the live route.
The development branch and adjacent issue repair were updated within two days.
Offline preparation with temporarily absent interfaces is common in live-show systems.
The behavior applies to any JACK audio client or hardware interface that disappears temporarily.
Preserving routes prevents session edits from disrupting downstream mixer and interface assignments.

ranking.deliveryNote: Readiness is an evidence-based human assessment, not a calibrated probability. Unknown inputs are never scored as facts.
